events.boundary: Mechanism SN1 selected by the selectivity rule table: tertiary substrate (tert_butyl_bromide) + weak nucleophile (water) at 25°C. March ch. 10: tertiary + weak nucleophile → SN1 (carbocation intermediate, racemisation). The reaction is driven to completion on command — no yield claim is made, and the kinetic selectivity ratios are not modelled
events.name: haloalkane:SN1

reason.en: HBr gas uptake uses the dissociative Henry constant from the CC-BY Sander compilation, converted from concentration to the dilute molal standard state. The reaction enthalpy is derived from its local temperature slope and solvent-density correction, not an independent calorimetric measurement. {temperature} Gas transfer is an equilibrium boundary, not a time-dependent absorption model.

phrase.en: Away from 25 °C this uses a local constant-enthalpy van't Hoff approximation, not a validated broad-temperature correlation.

events.what: HBr gas uptake uses the dissociative Henry constant from the CC-BY Sander compilation, converted from concentration to the dilute molal standard state.
